question: The first Governor of RBI was ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Sir Osborne Smith**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sir Osborne Smith** was the first Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).
 
• He served as the Governor from **April 1, 1935**, to **June 30, 1937**.
 
• Sir Osborne Smith was a professional banker and had previously worked with the **Bank of New South Wales**.
 
• He was appointed as the RBI Governor during the British rule in India.
 
• His tenure was marked by the initial establishment and organization of the RBI.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Role
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Governor
 The highest-ranking official in the Reserve Bank of India, responsible for overseeing the bank's functions.
 
 

 Deputy Governor
 An official who assists the Governor in the management of the RBI, usually there are multiple Deputy Governors.
 
 

 Monetary Policy
 Policies formulated by the RBI to control the supply of money, often targeting inflation or interest rates.
 
 

 Banking Regulation
 The process by which the RBI oversees and regulates banks to ensure financial stability.
 
 

 Currency Issuance
 The RBI is responsible for the issuance and supply of the Indian currency notes and coins.
 
 

 Financial Inclusion
 Efforts made by the RBI to ensure that all sections of society have access to financial services.
 
 

 Foreign Exchange Management
 The RBI manages the Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA) and oversees foreign exchange transactions in India.
 
 

 Payment Systems
 The RBI regulates and supervises payment systems to ensure smooth and secure transactions.
